quantity: C3 lattice rotation on the 3x3 doubled-Fibonacci GS manifold: does it split the chiral pair?
scope: One lattice size (3x3), one model. 'Splits' means the pair is SEPARATED, not LABELED: M_R is real, so complex conjugation K maps the omega-eigenvector to the omega-bar-eigenvector; the tau/tau-bar assignment remains a convention. No extraction proof for full signed S/T.

load_bearing.note: These could have failed. They carry the verdict.

structurally_forced.note: WARNING (independent-verification finding, 15 July 2026): once M_R is real+orthogonal+order-3 (G3/G4), its eigenvalues lie exactly on the cube roots of unity and complex ones come in conjugate pairs. For 4x4 exactly THREE spectra are possible: {1,1,1,1}, {1,1,w,wbar}, {w,wbar,w,wbar}. The agreement with the theory ST spectrum therefore selects 1 of 3 (log2(3)=1.585 bit) and is NOT a precision measurement. The residual ~1e-15 is floating-point noise. The antisymmetric norm is likewise forced by the spectrum, not measured: a bare 120-degree rotation block reproduces it with no lattice at all.

contrast_wilson_loops.note: Sec.III B's own metric. The contrast is real but is a consequence of G3/G4, not an independent measurement.

discarded_measure.note: spread was pre-registered but is DISCARDED by the author: M_R does not commute with M_i, so it does not preserve M_i's degenerate eigenspace; spread is a compression, not a restriction spectrum. Not load-bearing.

consistency_check_rotation_centers.note: These three centers are not three independent routes. On an LxL torus the C3 edge permutation depends on the center only through (j-i) mod 3, so (0, 0) and (1, 1) lie in the same class and their entries here coincide field for field. This block is a consistency check on the optimizer, not an independent repetition; the independent repetition in this work is the second lattice size. See center_equivalence_note in p6_lattice_extraction.json and p6_center_independence.py.
